set.name: YMBTCG
set.longname: Yo Mama Balls: the Trading Card Game

card.name: Six Seven
card.text: Six Seven enters tapped unless you pay 7 to cast it. 6: Six Seven cannot be removed from the board and health cannot go past 1 until next Start. 7: Six Seven gives all Livings "T: Deal 7 combat damage."

card.name: Slop
card.text: T,: Deal 3 combat damage Whenever an opponent Living is killed and Slop is on the board, that card turns face down and becomes a Slop Token that says “Take 1 damage during your start.”

card.name: Rage Bait
card.text: When an opponent plays a spell, you may play this card to Interrupt played spell by sending it to the discard. If the effects of the opposing spell have already transpired, this card does nothing.

card.name: YAOI BLAST
card.text: Destroy any Living or Object. When cast, you may pay 4 more to destroy all Livings or Objects.

card.name: RDM
card.text: Untap all Livings. All opponent Livings with the ability to deal damage must tap to fight a Living you don't control.

card.name: Communist Overtaking
card.text: Each player puts all of their coins into a shared pool. Then, starting with the player who had the fewest coins (if there is a tie, player who cast spell decides order), each player takes X coins from the pool in counter clockwise order until the pool is empty or every player has X coins. Any remaining coins goes back to their respective players. Any player may pay X+7 to negate this card all together.

card.name: Make a Move
card.text: Pull any number of cards out of your Discard back into your hand. All opponents draw 1 card.

card.name: Sir Goons'alot
card.text: T,: Destroy any Living. It returns to the owner's battlefield during the next End.

card.name: Gnome
card.text: T,: Deal 1 damage.

card.name: Faust, Tiefling Rogue
card.text: Dagger Toss - T,: Deal 3 damage to any Living. If Faust kills a Living, draw 1 card.

card.name: Suken, Sun Monk
card.text: Fury of Blows - T,: Deal 4 combat damage to any two Livings. If there are no livings on target players board, deal damage directly to Player.

card.name: Alixei, Fiend Warlock
card.text: T: Deal 2 damage Thunderclap - X, T: Deal X damage to all Living. If you or opponent have no living on the field, destroy any Object on each opponents field.

card.name: Tao Ming's Guidance
card.text: T,: Any attack made at target creature can be redirected to any Living. Sacrifice Tao Ming's Guidance.

card.name: Goblin Glemmy
card.text: Deal X damage to any living. If you kill that living, gain Gold based on its power level.

card.name: Gromp Warrior
card.text: During your Start phase, place a Gromp counter on Gromp Warrior. When Gromp Warrior has 2 gromp counters, flip this card.

card.name: Infinite Money Machine
card.text: This card creates an additional 3 gold during your Start phase. If you control 0 living, Infinite Money Machine gets sent to the Discard.

card.name: Job Application
card.text: T: Flip a coin. On heads, gain 3 coin. On tails, gain 1 coin.

card.name: TAUNTED!!
card.text: Any Object becomes a 1 health Living with 3 power level until the end of the turn.

card.name: VC Night
card.text: Attach this to a Living when played. Partner - X: You may attach this to an additional Living on the board, where X is the Play Cost of that creature. All creatures attached to VC Night share a combined life total. When the life total is 0 or VC Night is destroyed, all attached Livings and VC Night go to Discard.

card.name: Cookie Jar
card.text: Destroy a Living, then draw cards based on the health of that Living.

card.name: Security Guard's Shift
card.text: Overtime - T,: Gain 2 coins.

card.name: Urmomerbal
card.text: T,: Look at top 3 cards of deck. Return them in any order.

card.name: Group’s Personal Scribe
card.text: Whenever opponent plays object or spell, that player may pay 2 coins or puts the top 2 cards of their deck to the Discard. If their library is empty after this effect triggers, gain 6 coins.

card.name: Power Scaling
card.text: T,: Gain 4 coins if you control the highest power Living.

card.name: Kin Assignment
card.text: Kin Assignment becomes copy of any permanent until end of turn.

card.name: BIG ASS DINOSAUR
card.text: Snack Time - T,: Deals 5 damage. If BIG ASS DINOSAUR kills a Living, untap all cards you control.

card.name: Yahni’s Stream
card.text: Search your Library or Discard for a card and put that card into your hand. Shuffle your library.

card.name: Dante, Crooked Vigilante
card.text: T: Deal 3 damage. Pay 1 Life, T: Deal 6 damage. Pay 2 Life, T: Deal 3 damage to all living an opponent controls.

card.name: Mighty, the Destined Hero
card.text: Bardic Inspiration - T,: Deal 3 damage. If Mighty killed a Living this turn with Bardic Inspiration, all Livings in your discard gains "2: Return this Living to the battlefield" until you untap Mighty.

card.name: Vigorous, Cape of Hope
card.text: T,: Deal 4 damage. When Vigorous, Cape of Hope enters the battlefield, destroy two Objects.

card.name: COMMAND GRAB
card.text: Destroy any Living.

card.name: GRUNGLE
card.text: When GRUNGLE enters the battlefield, choose between Object or Living to your opponents. Put cards from the top of your library into your Discard until you find an Object or Living (decided by your pick). Deal damage to a player equal to the amount of cards sent to your Discard this way. T,: Deal 5 damage.

card.name: BRAINROT
card.text: Any time an opponent discards a card, gain 3 coins for each card discarded.

card.name: Grungle Mox
card.text: Each player draws an additional card during their draw step when this card is on the field. Sacrifice this object at the end of your next turn.

card.name: AI Generated Spell
card.text: When an opponent plays a card, you may play this card to Interrupt played card by sending it to the discard. Gain chips based on the play cost of the card you countered.

card.name: 5 mg weed gummy from gas station
card.text: T,: Discard any number of cards, and draw that many cards.

card.name: Chud
card.text: T,: Deal 1 damage. If this Living remains on the field after an opponent deals damage with a Living, flip this card.

card.name: Chad
card.text: T,: Deal 5 damage.
